answer:

Fictional workshop. France (disclosed workshop mandate): retain the adopted term. United Kingdom (inferred workshop mandate): public summary without a confidential annex. A workshop proposal or impasse establishes no official vote, authority or commitment. A change to the adopted mandate term would require Council authorization.
